criteria.requirement: Use existing half-open line ranges for block-level positioning; child tokens and transformations do not supply complete original character/byte offsets. Define document revision, normalization, Unicode indexing and desired selection granularity before proposing an exact mapping layer. Do not claim arbitrary HTML can be losslessly reversed or a nonexistent offset field already solves it.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
